Class PlainSocket

java.lang.Object
com.alexswd.top.network.tcp.SocketBase
com.alexswd.top.network.tcp.PlainSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISocket
public class PlainSocket extends SocketBase
Plain socket implementation extending SocketBase.

This class provides a concrete, non-encrypted socket implementation. It extends SocketBase and can be used for unencrypted TCP socket communication.
